name: 03 - Fiscália: Sub-Workflow de Tools do Agente (LC 214 & RAG)

parameters.query:
SELECT
  s.slug AS sector_slug,
  s.name AS sector_name,
  s.description AS sector_description,
  s.cnae_examples,
  m.regime_type,
  m.estimated_effective_rate,
  m.reduction_percent,
  m.legal_basis,
  m.credit_rules,
  m.key_obligations,
  m.transition_schedule
FROM public.tax_reform_matrix m
JOIN public.sectors s ON s.slug = m.sector_slug
WHERE (
  COALESCE(array_length($1::text[], 1), 0) > 0
  AND s.slug = ANY($1::text[])
)
OR (
  COALESCE(array_length($1::text[], 1), 0) = 0
  AND $2::uuid IS NOT NULL
  AND s.slug IN (
    SELECT us.sector_slug
    FROM public.user_subscriptions us
    WHERE us.user_id = $2::uuid
  )
)
OR (
  COALESCE(array_length($1::text[], 1), 0) = 0
  AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_subscriptions us WHERE us.user_id = $2::uuid))
)
ORDER BY s.slug
LIMIT 12;
